The build-context job uses ./.github/workflows/reusable-context.yml, which then uses a python environment.  Since this project uses a complex, machine-specific dependency graph, building the same set of dependencies repeatedly could be a significant bottleneck.

The check-docs job uses ./.github/workflows/reusable-docs.yml.  Since this workflow shares dependencies with build-context, it could be repeatedly building these. This represents at least 100s in execution time.
The check-autoconf-regen job builds a custom autoconf environment with a submodule.  This relies heavily on the source of the code so it must be rebuilt for new git commits.
The check-generated-files job rebuilds CPython files from scratch.  This represents another build artifact generation, that shares a dependency graph with the main build.

The check-c-api-docs workflow contains an external build that generates C API documentation from source code; while this creates a separate set of artifacts, it may benefit from sharing dependencies with `build-windows`.
The build-windows jobs uses a separate setup for Windows.  This process will rebuild everything from scratch.
The build-windows-msi jobs builds an MSI package.  This process will rebuild everything from scratch
The build-macos jobs use a separate setup for MacOS.  This process will rebuild everything from scratch
The build-ubuntu jobs use a separate setup for Ubuntu.  This process will rebuild everything from scratch
The build-ubuntu-ssltests jobs includes running a custom SSL test suite.  It rebuilds everything from scratch for tests.
The build-ios jobs is using macOS and builds iOS packages.
The build-emscripten jobs builds an Emscripten build from source.
The build-wasi jobs builds a WASI build from source.
The test-hypothesis job runs hypothesis tests, and each run is separate, while it may benefit from caching.
The build-asan job builds a build with AddressSanitizer enabled from source.
The build-san job builds a build with Sanitizers enabled from source.
The cross-build-linux jobs builds a cross-compiled target, builds everything from scratch.
The cifuzz jobs performs fuzzing builds from source; it should leverage caching for new source.
